notes.title: There's Chaos! Dev Roadmap
notes.content:
[b]Hey Pilots![/b]

The chaos has only just begun! It’s been an incredible ride bringing this game to life - mostly as a solo developer, with some much-appreciated help along the way. Seeing players dive in and experience the chaos has been amazing, but I know this is only the beginning.

I’ve been so focused on pushing updates that I haven’t shared a clear big-picture vision for the future… until now. So let’s fix that! Here’s what’s coming next for [i]There's Chaos![/i] and how we’re going to take the game to the next level. We’re not stopping here!

[h2]The Future of Chaos: What’s Coming?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Tutorial[/b] – A smoother, better onboarding experience for new players.
[*] [b]Localization[/b] – Play [i]There's Chaos![/i] in your native language.
[*] [b]Seam Achievements[/b] – Show off your skills and unlock bragging rights.
[*] [b]Co-op Multiplayer[/b] – Team up with friends to take on AI enemies together.
[*] [b]PvP & PvPvE Multiplayer[/b] – Battle against human players, AI, or both—choose to cooperate or dominate!
[*] [b]New Weapons, Upgrades & Maps[/b] – More tools of destruction, more battlegrounds, more replayability.
[*] [b]Improved Visual Effects[/b] – A more polished, immersive, and explosive experience.
[*] [b]Performance Optimizations[/b] – Smoother, faster, better.
[*] [b]Steam Deck & Console Support[/b] – Play anywhere, anytime!
[/list]
[h2]The Chaos Roadmap[/h2]

Here's how the current roadmap looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529206/21f6b6ca6ee72ea4ce57151761e0444532a8a8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Phase I (2-3 months)[/b]: Localization, Tutorial, Co-op Multiplayer, Steam achievements, Improved Visuals and Performance Optimizations.
[*] [b]Phase II (5-6 months)[/b]: PvP & PvPvE, More Content, More Visual Upgrades and More Optimizations.
[*] [b]Phase III (2-3 months)[/b]: Steam Deck & Console Support - bringing the chaos to even more platforms!
[/list]
Estimated total development time: [b]10-12 months[/b] - but only with the support needed to make it happen.

[h2]Want to Help Keep the Chaos Going?[/h2]

Game development is no small feat, and as a solo dev, I’m doing everything I can to keep the momentum strong. Continuing development at this pace depends on the game receiving enough support and I need your support to make this happen! Here's how you can help with this:

[list]
[*] Get the game on Steam or support development via [url=https://gofund.me/de5a6944]GoFundMe[/url].
[*] Spread the word! Tell your friends, share on social media, and help grow the community.
[*] Join the conversation! [url=https://linktr.ee/thereschaos]Connect with us[/url] to stay in the loop.
[*] Give feedback! Your ideas and input shape the future of the game.
[/list]
The journey isn’t over - it's just getting started. The more support we get, the faster and bigger these updates can roll out. Let's build the ultimate chaotic experience together!

notes.title: Prep Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This patch contains a few updated visual effects as well as a few other small changes made in the background that you will not feel currently in gameplay. These are things to prepare the game for development towards the next big milestone - Co-op Multiplayer!

I'm realizing that I've been patching the game really often, but did not offer players any big picture view on these and where we see the game heading. [b]So I'll be putting up a future development roadmap soon![/b]

Just wanted to let you all know that releasing the game was not the finish line for it's development. It's just the start! And I'm hoping I can grab your feedback during the development process, so we end up with really good game that as players we can all enjoy, together!

notes.title: Eye-candy Patch 1.0.6 notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thanks so much for all your support!

This patch is oriented towards the visual effects and contains the following changes.

VFX added or replaced:

[list]
[*] Muzzle flash for cannons, scatterguns and Gattling guns
[*] Bullet trail for cannons and scatterguns projectiles
[*] Actual flame for the Flamethrower
[*] Camera shake when shooting with projectile weapons (flamethrower is not affected) - it's very subtle though
[/list]

I do hope you'll enjoy it and I can't wait to hear your feedback! Have fun and happy gaming!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! o/

This patch features:

[list]
[*] A little scaled up enemies - for better visibility
[*] Enemies accuracy bias depending on the difficulty settings
[*] Camera zoom - use the mouse scroll or controller left up/down buttons to zoom in or out
[*] Dynamic enemy markers - the red enemy markers now scale and have opacity based on the distance between you and the enemy drone. This should help you tell which ones are closer or farther relative to your position
[*] Radar - there's a radar which points you towards enemy locations now. This should help determine faster where the enemies are situated
[/list]


Looking forward for any feedback you have! <3

notes.title: Small update 1.0.3
notes.content: Small change to show the map unlock requirements. After some feedback, I realized these were not very visible to players. :(

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This small patch, a day after the game released is about improvements for the 3rd map. It's unlikely anyone unlocked it yet, but if you did, you will see a change in scenery. \o/

As always, I'm looking forward to hearing all your feedback about the game, gameplay, what should be worked more on and what can be improved. Thank you for all the support!
